title: Add escalation SLO views (time-to-ack, time-to-mitigation) + weekly export
author: Allison Grant
release_notes: Adds two escalation-focused SLO views (time-to-ack and time-to-mitigation) and a weekly CSV export used in the Support+SRE review cadence. No changes to paging/alerting behavior.
body:
Context: As part of the Escalation Playbook v2 + known-issues sprint, Support and SRE need a consistent, auditable way to review escalation response and mitigation timelines each week. Today we can compute incident SLOs, but support escalations are tracked inconsistently (Slack threads / Jira / incident-bot) and the numbers are hard to reproduce.

This PR adds first-class "support escalation" SLO views in slo-toolkit and a standard export that can be attached to the weekly Support+SRE review doc.

Definitions (aligned with SRE + Support policy draft): time_to_ack (TTA) = first acknowledgement timestamp - escalation_created timestamp. Ack is the first of: incident-bot form completion, oncall ack event, or a manual ack marker posted by incident-bot ("acknowledged") in #incidents. time_to_mitigation (TTM) = mitigation_applied timestamp - escalation_created timestamp. Mitigation is the first timestamp of: incident marked "mitigated" in incident-bot, or a manual mitigation marker ("mitigation applied") posted by incident-bot. If an escalation never becomes an incident, TTA/TTM are still computed from the escalation timeline.

What’s included: (1) New warehouse views: support_escalations_v1, support_escalation_slo_daily_v1, support_escalation_slo_weekly_v1. These are built from the existing incident_events table plus the support_escalations table populated by incident-bot. (2) A new CLI/export command: `slo-toolkit export support-escalations --week 2026-02-16 --out csv` that emits a stable column set used by Product Ops for the weekly deck. (3) A small docs page describing how the metrics are computed, caveats, and how to interpret missing timestamps.

Export columns (stable contract): week_start, escalation_id, severity, customer_tier, deployment_mode (hosted|dedicated|private), region, model (if present), created_at, ack_at, mitigated_at, time_to_ack_minutes, time_to_mitigation_minutes, owner_team (best-effort), incident_id (nullable), linked_jira (nullable), linked_linear (nullable), notes (nullable).

Operational notes: This is read-only and does not change any alerting thresholds. Missing ack/mitigation timestamps are represented as empty fields and excluded from percentile calculations. PII/customer identifiers are not exported; escalation_id is the internal key used by incident-bot, and the export is intended for internal review only.

Follow-ups (not in this PR): wiring a scheduled job to push the CSV into the shared drive; adding tier-based targets into the weekly view once PM-612 lands.

Testing: Added unit tests for timestamp selection precedence and week bucketing, plus a golden-file test for CSV output ordering.

Screenshots/Examples: Example output attached in docs (sample rows with redacted ids).
commits: warehouse: add support_escalations_v1 view and event normalization
warehouse: compute escalation TTA/TTM daily + weekly rollups
cli: add export support-escalations (csv) with stable columns
docs: document escalation SLO definitions + caveats
tests: add timestamp precedence + csv golden file
review_thread: Sean Gallagher (requested changes): "Metric definitions look good, but I’m worried about using 'first message in #incidents' as ack because it can be spammy. Can we restrict ack to incident-bot ack event or explicit marker only?" Allison Grant (author): "Good call. I removed the 'first message' fallback. Ack is now: incident-bot ack event OR explicit 'acknowledged' marker posted by incident-bot." Rafael Mendes (comment): "Can you clarify precedence when ack happens before incident creation? e.g., Support escalates, oncall acks in the support thread, incident created later." Allison: "Updated docs + logic: ack is independent of incident creation; we take the earliest qualifying ack event attached to the escalation_id." Dev Patel (comment): "Export needs tier + deployment_mode so we can segment Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private in the weekly meeting." Allison: "Added both columns; tier is best-effort from escalation metadata (incident-bot form), deployment_mode from product surface tag." Chris Osei (requested changes): "CSV needs a stable ordering + explicit week_start column; otherwise it’s hard to diff week over week." Allison: "Added week_start as first column and enforced deterministic ordering by (created_at, escalation_id). Added golden-file test." Sean Gallagher (approval): "Approved. This gives us consistent weekly numbers without extra analyst work." Rafael Mendes (approval): "LGTM after the ack fallback change." Dev Patel (approval): "Looks good; aligns with the playbook drafts."
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash merge. Post-merge note: Chris Osei will pilot the weekly export in the 2026-02-23 Support+SRE review.
